answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A opal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the onyx of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
